result.title: Anchoring VAE Fine-Tuning to Its Latent Diffusion Prior
result.summary: Pretrained latent diffusion models are effective priors for transfer learning, from geometry estimation to physics simulation. Existing approaches fine-tune the diffusion backbone but freeze the encoder of the VAE to preserve the latent distribution. However, a frozen encoder may miss salient details in non-RGB inputs and is limited to three channels. We introduce Diffusion Prior Anchoring (DPA), a regularizer applied during VAE fine-tuning that uses a score-distillation update to steer latents toward the high-density manifold on which the pretrained diffusion model denoises accurately. We validate DPA across three image and video models (FLUX 3, LTX-Video, Wan2.2) and four tasks: monocular depth estimation, MRI reconstruction, wind-flow simulation, and surface normal estimation, where DPA lowers the prediction error by 7.5% relative to the frozen VAE, 4.9% to decoder-only fine-tuning, and 4.0% to unanchored VAE fine-tuning. Its gain grows the further the target data lies from the RGB training distribution, from 3.3% on monocular depth estimation to 7.2% on complex-valued MRI. DPA also applies to modified VAEs, including pruned and multi-channel variants. With a four-channel VAE that encodes depth and surface normals, it lowers depth estimation error by 9.3%.

AI.brief_summary: 针对迁移学习中冻结 VAE 编码器会丢失非 RGB 输入细节、且受三通道限制的问题，提出 Diffusion Prior Anchoring：在 VAE 微调时用 score-distillation 式更新把 latent 约束回预训练扩散模型可靠去噪的高密度流形，并在深度、MRI、风场、法向估计四个任务上验证预测误差下降。
AI.relevance_reason: 直接触及「任务必要的几何与视觉细节是否保留在潜在内部状态」这一表示问题，冻结编码器的信息损失与 latent 偏离先验流形可作为信息坍缩的对照线索，可供核查；但该工作为单次前向的密集预测/回归，不涉及推理期 latent 状态生成与停止决策，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 关联有限。
